title: Touchpoint Sprint Retrospective & Upcoming Cadence — Samir / AE sync
content:
Meeting purpose: quick retrospective on last sprint of touchpoints with Lighthouse Retail; align on renewal asks, technical blockers, and immediate next steps for the next 14 days.

Attendees (planned): Samir Kapoor (CS), Amira Bennett (AE), Diego Marquez (SE - optional), Account Exec: Priya N. (cc), Note taker: Samir.

Context snapshot (one-liners):
- Contract renewal window: May 2026 (formal notice due 2026-04-15).
- Current MRR: $43.2k; runway target to hit +10% expansion before renewal.
- Usage trend: steady for embeddings, gen tokens down 18% last 3 weeks (seasonal + sandbox pruning).
- Commercial ask outstanding: approval for Dedicated pool pilot (requested by Infra team at Lighthouse).
- Technical flag: latency spikes reported for long-context prompts (seq>2048). SE investigating quantization fallback on T4 nodes.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick wins since last sync (5m) — what shipped, what moved the needle.
2) Risks & escalations (8m) — product gaps, commercial blockers.
3) Renewal positioning & proposed asks (8m) — price/feature anchoring.
4) Tactical next 14-day plan + owners (7m).

Quick wins (what to call out):
- Reduced error rate in inference pipeline by 12% after routing tweak last week (note: SRE telemetry shows fewer 5xxs).
- Delivered expanded logging bundle to Lighthouse devs — improved root-cause triage time.
- AE secured intro to Head of Cart Ops (increases expansion opportunity).

Risks / open issues to discuss: (be explicit, assign immediate owner)
- Risk A: Dedicated pilot delay — procurement hasn't signed SOW. Impact: blocks capacity guarantees for their holiday spike. Owner: Amira to re-open procurement thread; ask for timeline from procurement by EOD+3.
- Risk B: Latency regressions for long context — customer-facing demos affected. Owner: Diego to surface mitigations (quantization profile + fallback route to larger GPU) and propose temporary SLA note.
- Risk C: Billing discrepancy for Feb overage ($2.7k) — finance hold prevents PO submission. Owner: Samir to coordinate with BillingOps and share reconciliation sheet with Lighthouse CFO.

Key talking points / scripts for AE (short bullets):
- Re: Dedicated pilot — "We can stage a non-prod dedicated pool scoped to your holiday peak; SOW can be scoped to a max-hour commitment with rollback clauses to reduce procurement friction."
- Re: Latency — "We're treating the long-context latency as a top priority; we can demo the fallback path that guarantees sub-150ms p50 for the use cases you've flagged."
- Re: Billing — "We propose a one-time credit for Feb while we reconcile token attribution; aim is to prevent PO freeze and keep pilot timelines intact."

Questions I want Priya/AE to answer in the meeting: (prep before call)
- What is the procurement team's typical approval cadence and blockers (legal/finance/security)?
- Who can sign an ephemeral SOW or pilot addendum (name/email)?
- Which Lighthouse features are highest priority to keep showing value (cart personalization vs search rerank)?

Proposed asks of Lighthouse this week:
- Approval to run a 2-week non-prod Dedicated pilot window starting 2026-03-22 (deliverables: baseline perf, KV cache hit ratio, cost delta).
- Access to a product manager for 2x 30-min sessions to verify acceptance criteria for the Dedicated pilot.
- Confirmation on how Feb billing dispute will be handled (payment timeline or credit request).

Measurable success criteria for next check-in (14 days):
- Procurement provides tentative sign-off date or explicit blocker list (owner: Amira).
- SE delivers mitigation plan for latency with schedule and test plan (owner: Diego).
- Billing reconciliation sheet shared and accepted for the disputed amount (owner: Samir).
- Engagement uplift: +5% token usage on targeted rerank route (tracked in dashboard).

Action items (clear, concise, with due dates):
- Amira: Re-open procurement thread; request sign-off timeline and name of approver. Due: 2026-03-12.
- Diego: Run two profiling experiments (quantization profile A/B) and capture p50/p95 for seq=4096; share results and short mitigation plan. Due: 2026-03-15.
- Samir: Deliver billing reconciliation CSV to Lighthouse CFO and BillingOps (cc: finance@redwood); propose credit language. Due: 2026-03-11.
- Priya (AE): Get PM contact at Lighthouse and schedule two 30-min sessions for pilot acceptance criteria. Due: 2026-03-14.
- Samir/Amira: Draft a one-page pilot SOW with rollback and cost cap language; circulate for legal quick review. Due: 2026-03-16.

Notes to self (things to capture during the call):
- Exact procurement objections (do not paraphrase; capture wording).
- Name and title of person who can sign addenda.
- Any internal Lighthouse deadlines that would accelerate approval.
- Tone of CFO on disputed charges (soft/hard).

Post-call follow-up template (copy/paste & customize):
Subject: Follow-up: Lighthouse pilot next steps + action items (Samir/Amira)
Hi <Priya>,
Thanks for the sync earlier — good alignment. Per our notes, next steps: 1) Amira to follow up on procurement and share approver name by 2026-03-12; 2) Diego to deliver latency mitigation plan by 2026-03-15; 3) Samir to share billing reconciliation by 2026-03-11.
I'll attach the reconcilliation CSV and the first draft SOW in a follow-up thread. Please reply with any discrepancies.

Reflection & coaching notes for my own follow-up (private):
- Keep escalation tone collaborative, not defensive. Focus on risk mitigation and value capture.
- Ask more open questions when AE meets procurement — "What's the one thing keeping you from greenlighting this?"
- Track sentiment shift across calls (label: neutral / positive / cautious / defensive).

Parking lot (items not for this meeting):
- Long-term architecture recommendations for Lighthouse's cart rerank pipeline.
- Pricing model deep-dive for committed capacity (defer until after pilot).

Bottom line: this call needs to convert procurement ambiguity into an explicit blocker list or a tentative sign-off date. If we have that, we can keep the pilot timeline and hit the renewal expansion target.

=== End of note ===
